answer: Treat admission as a scarce climb: each agent parks non-fungible collateral on a shared settlement mesa and must keep publishing a signed liveness pulse that already-established neighbors can verify. Weight accrues only after several independent attestors bridge that pulse back to the identical locked bond. A sybil swarm cannot cheaply multiply influence, because splitting the bond starves every clone's pulse of countersignatures, and unsigned identities never grade or vote.
